text:
Samir: Heads-up — onboarding PulseFin's LoRA adapter. Quick eval showed small but consistent amount rounding in invoices after int4 quantization. TL;DR: fp16 baseline OK, q4 shows 0.01-0.05 skew on some samples.

Megan: oof. do you have the quickpack outputs and which quant config?

Samir: Ran: ./evalpack/run_quickpack.sh --model base-variant-fp16 --adapter pulsefin-lora.safetensors --quant q4_0 --prompts tests/pulsefin/invoice-amounts.jsonl
Output snippet (q4_0 vs fp16):
{"id":"inv-014","fp16_amount":"1234.50","q4_amount":"1234.47","delta":-0.03}
{"id":"inv-021","fp16_amount":"0.00","q4_amount":"0.02","delta":+0.02}
{"id":"inv-078","fp16_amount":"9.99","q4_amount":"9.94","delta":-0.05}
Full pack: s3://redwood-evals/pulsefin/quickpack/1743214321/

Ravi: is adapter doing arithmetic or templated completions?

Samir: Mostly templated LM completions; prompts include currency symbols and formatted numbers. Suspect tokenizer merges — some templates use thin-space thousands separator.

Tay: paste one failing prompt? token boundaries can split digits/punct.

Samir: Example:
Prompt:
"Generate invoice total for items: [\"Subscription: $9.99\", \"Overage: $0.00\"] -> Total:"
Expected: "$9.99"
q4 output: "$9.94"

Julie: tiny numeric drift usually quant noise amplified by greedy decoding on numeric tokens. Did you hold decoding constant?

Samir: yes, greedy for both. tried top-p too — similar skew, more variance.

Megan: two asks: 1) tokenizer diffs between fp16 and q4 tokenization around digits/punct, 2) per-token logits saved for a few failing examples to diff pre-softmax.

Ravi: I'll take logits diffs. Samir re-run failing 20 examples with --save-logits and --max-tokens 128; upload to same s3 path.

Samir: re-run started (ETA ~8m).

ci-bot: Deployment check: pulsefin-lora adapter passed model-signing and checksum validation.

Samir: re-run complete. uploaded logs to s3://redwood-evals/pulsefin/quickpack/1743214321/logits/

Ravi: quick look: inv-078 shows fp16 logit for "." after 9.99 ~ -1.2 vs q4 ~ -1.8; final digit token has delta ~ -0.3. Bias toward lower digit scores under q4.

Megan: suggests qpack asymmetric quant zero-point or kernel scaling. Which qpack toolchain? llama.cpp q4_0 or our q4_aw?

Samir: q4_0 via vendored qpack (same as other quickpacks). We have q4_aw sandbox but not run with adapter.

Tay: try q4_aw + disable kv-cache warmstart. cached normalization sometimes interacts with quant.

Samir: queued q4_aw run with kv warmstart off. Also added prompt variant stripping thousands separators.

Julie: also test merge-then-quant (apply LoRA into fp16 then quantize) vs runtime LoRA on q4 — might differ a lot.

Samir: running both: a) merge-loRA-into-fp16 then quantize, b) runtime-lora-on-q4. Merged run ETA ~12m.

Ravi: if merged-then-quant fixes bias, we should recommend that path in customer remediation notes.

Samir: merged+q4 results: median delta ~0.01, outliers ~0.03. runtime-lora-on-q4 median ~0.04. Artifacts uploaded.

Megan: create targeted eval: 100 templated invoices varying separators, currencies, magnitudes (0.00, 10,000.00, 9999999.99). Score = abs delta normalized + format-preserved flag.

Samir: will run overnight. pass/fail: abs_delta > 0.02 for amounts <100, >0.1 for amounts >1e6.

Tay: also measure token-level bias distribution and report percentage of tokens with systematic negative bias >0.1 across samples.

Megan: assign canary policy: if >5% samples fail, block q4 rollout for PulseFin until mitigations (merge-then-quant or q4_aw profile) applied.

Samir: noted. running targeted pack; will upload in morning. adding escalation note recommending prompt-mitigation: enforce exact two-decimal format via system instruction to temporarily reduce customer impact.

ci-bot: quickpack run completed; artifact uploaded (3.2MB).

Ravi: we'll triage in standup tomorrow and draft remediation doc: options = merged quant, q4_aw profile, or keep fp16 for money calculations.

Julie: add prompt mitigation example: "Return amounts as EXACT two-decimal digits with leading $; do not add separators." That often helps.

Samir: added to notes and will include delta.py diff scripts from evalpack/scripts for reproducibility. tagging @ravi @megan for follow-up. :coffee:
